title: 八万六
music: warm emotional rural drama underscore turning suspenseful, soft piano, erhu, gentle strings, then low pulsing tension, instrumental, no vocals
logline: His father gives Xiaokang his life savings to start a farm-produce shop; in the city, Xiaokang secretly films Gao Liang paying off the village chief.

clips.summary: That night in {loc}, {shoudi} asks if they were rash; {xiaokang} says the contract is a contract of servitude.
clips.soundscape: Quiet farmhouse night: crickets outside, a bulb buzzing faintly.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.line: 儿啊，咱们今天，是不是冲动了些？
cuts.say: 儿啊……咱们今天，是不是冲动了些？
cuts.act: 欲言又止，低声，满是担忧
cuts.delivery: worried, hesitant, turning an unlit pipe in his fingers
cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi} sitting at the square table under the bare bulb, centre-left of the frame.
cuts.action: {shoudi} turns an unlit pipe in his fingers and looks up at his son.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 爸，这哪是合同，分明就是卖身契！
cuts.say: 爸，这哪是合同……分明就是卖身契！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} standing in the doorway, warm bulb light on his face.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} slaps the contract down on the table.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {shoudi} worries that with the land gone they only have the shares; {xiaokang} goes to the window, looks at the moonlit jujube tree and says he has a plan.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.line: 这地要是被征了，咱家就剩那几张股票了。
cuts.say: 这地要是被征了……咱家，就剩那几张股票了。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi} at the table, the bulb casting deep shadows on his lined face.
cuts.action: {shoudi} puts the pipe down and sighs.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of {xiaokang} walking to the old wooden window of {loc}; moonlight and the jujube tree's shadow fall across him.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} stops at the window and looks out at the moonlit courtyard.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude, at slow speed.
cuts.end: He turns back toward the room.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.act: 转过身，眼神坚定，语气沉稳
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} by the window, moonlight on one side of his face, bulb light on the other.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} turns to his father, eyes steady.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {xiaokang} says he will open a farm-produce shop in the city and work for himself; {shoudi} silently gets up and goes into the inner room.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 我要去城里开一家农产品直销店。
cuts.say: 我要去城里……开一家农产品直销店。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} at the table, leaning toward his father.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} leans forward, hands flat on the table.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 咱不给他打工，咱给自己打工！
cuts.say: 咱不给他打工——咱给自己打工！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame, eyes bright.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} taps the table with his knuckle on the last word.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of {shoudi} at the square table in {loc}.
cuts.action: {shoudi} stares at his son in silence, then gets up and goes through the cloth curtain into the inner room.
cuts.sound: The stool scrapes; the curtain rustles.

clips.summary: {shoudi} comes back with an old iron tin full of banknotes, his savings for his son's wedding, and gives it to him; {xiaokang} refuses, near tears.

cuts.composition: Medium shot at the square table of {loc}: {shoudi} sets {money_box} down in front of {xiaokang} and opens the lid.
cuts.action: Crumpled banknotes and passbooks fill the tin.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.line: 这是你爸攒了半辈子的，八万六，拿去！
cuts.say: 这是你爸攒了半辈子的……八万六。拿去！
cuts.act: 声音发颤又硬撑着，最后两个字很重
cuts.delivery: voice trembling but firm, pushing the tin forward
cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi} under the bulb, eyes wet.
cuts.action: {shoudi} pushes the tin toward his son with both hands.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.act: 哽咽，眼泪在眼眶里打转
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre-right of the frame.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} shakes his head, tears welling but not falling.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {shoudi} presses the tin into his hands and tells him he is no traitor but the village's best son; Xiaokang's inner voice says he was not abandoned, he was pushed forward.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.line: 你是我李守地的儿子，你不是叛徒！
cuts.say: 你是我李守地的儿子……你不是叛徒！
cuts.act: 把盒子重重按在儿子手上，声音拔高，老泪纵横
cuts.delivery: fierce, tears in his eyes, pressing the tin into his son's hands
cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi}, centre-left of the frame.
cuts.action: {shoudi} presses the tin hard into his son's hands.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 那一刻我才明白，我不是被全村抛弃了。
cuts.say: 那一刻我才明白……我不是被全村抛弃了。
cuts.act: 低沉的内心独白，压着哭腔，温热
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} gripping {money_box}, knuckles white, eyes brimming.
cuts.action: A single tear rolls down his cheek.
cuts.end: The shot ends on his eyes in extreme close-up.

clips.summary: In the city, {xiaokang} hides behind a tree and films {gaoliang} scolding the village chief on the restaurant steps.
clips.soundscape: City street ambience: passing traffic, footsteps, the revolving door turning.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of {xiaokang} half hidden behind the plane tree at {loc}, holding up his phone to film the restaurant entrance.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} raises his phone and starts recording, eyes narrowed.

cuts.speaker: gaoliang
cuts.line: 老子的钱就这么被弄走了，你这个村长一点办法没有？
cuts.say: 老子的钱……就这么被弄走了！你这个村长，一点办法没有？
cuts.act: 压低声音，咬牙切齿，凶狠
cuts.composition: Close-up of {gaoliang} on the restaurant steps, revolving door behind him.
cuts.action: {gaoliang} jabs a finger at the village chief's chest.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {fugui} fawns over {gaoliang} as he hands over a business card; behind the tree, {xiaokang} keeps filming as the SUV pulls away.
clips.soundscape: City street ambience: passing traffic, footsteps, the revolving door turning.

cuts.speaker: fugui
cuts.line: 高老板，您可真是我们黄谷村的大恩人啊！
cuts.say: 高老板……您可真是我们黄谷村的大恩人啊！
cuts.act: 点头哈腰，满脸堆笑，谄媚
cuts.delivery: fawning, bowing, gold tooth flashing in a grin
cuts.composition: Close-up of {fugui} on the restaurant steps, clutching a business card.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} behind the tree, phone raised, the restaurant entrance blurred behind him.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} keeps filming as a black SUV pulls away; his eyes narrow.
cuts.camera: Static camera, slow push in, with small amplitude.
